definition: A named outflow-compound in the āsava family.
notes: This compound should inherit the āsava headword policy. Keep outflow audible rather than flattening the term into generic ignorance or generic defilement-language.

example_phrases.notes: Shows a named member of the āsava family.

example_phrases.translation: the unarisen outflow of ignorance arises
example_phrases.notes: From the unwise-attention passage that opens MN 2.
